title: iproute2 commit e2613dc8 — add IFLA_NET_NS_PID support to ip link

date.notes: Upstream commit timestamp; commit message identifies Daniel Lezcano as original author.

claims_extracted.claim: The commit adds `ip link set DEVICE netns PID`, using IFLA_NET_NS_PID to move a device into the network namespace of a target process.
claims_extracted.locator: commit message; doc/ip-cref.tex; ip/iplink.c; man/man8/ip.8 diff
claims_extracted.notes: This proves an earlier process/PID-selected namespace administration interface.

notes: Chronological predecessor evidence only. It does not by itself prove that the later named `ip netns` command family was derived from this patch.
